context.content_translation:
7月7日
Camila 和 Rafael Martin
58 Hotspur Lane
Springfield, MO 63015
尊敬的 Camila 和 Rafael：
Palmyra Realty 的每个人都希望你们在新家安顿顺利。除了了解你们俩之外，在最后看房时，我很高兴见到你们的孩子们。

choices: There are several design experts in your neighborhood.
Palmyra Realty is sincerely grateful for your business.
Renting apartments has become competitive in Franklin County.
I have worked in real estate for twenty years.

D：我在房地产行业工作了二十年。
